transformer.name: application-cloudevents+json
transformer.title: Application Cloudevents+json
transformer.description: Adds default CloudEvent (JSon binding) headers to the Camel message (such as content-type, event source, event type etc.)

transformerIn.description: Any body as the data of the event, a null body as no data

transformerOut.description: The event in the Json format, unless the Content-Type header is application/cloudevents+json already: the body is kept then
